capabilities.justification: Writes capability_runtime_evidence.json, scratch strace traces and the Docker rootfs/profile under the caller-supplied evidence directory (a cargo target tmp dir).
Reads the strace trace it just wrote, the test binary and its ldd closure (to build the container rootfs), and /proc/self/fd for the inherited-descriptor audit.
Runs the test binary under strace -f as the independent observer (VER08b section 6).
Runs the container ring: docker import/run/rmi with a generated seccomp profile (VER08b section 7).
Lists the shared objects the test binary needs so the container rootfs contains them and nothing else.
Packs the container rootfs for docker import.
Reads PATH to find strace/docker, RCG_STRICT/RCG_REQUIRE_DOCKER switches and GITHUB_ACTIONS for the evidence file; the child audits its own environment against the manifest.
Prints TAP-style results, gate verdicts and failure ids.
Draws the per-run ARMED-marker nonce with getrandom.

capabilities.target: libc syscall landlock_create_ruleset, landlock_add_rule, landlock_restrict_self, seccomp, prctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS), open(O_PATH), close, write, setrlimit(RLIMIT_CORE), getrandom, uname, _exit; plus the sabotage controls' deliberately forbidden probes
capabilities.justification: There is no safe std API for seccomp, Landlock or no_new_privs; arming the sandbox is the purpose of the crate. The negative controls issue forbidden syscalls on purpose and only ever run after arming, where they are refused.

justification: The VER08b runtime capability gate. It must read and write evidence files, run strace/docker/ldd/tar, and use raw syscalls to install and test a sandbox. It is test infrastructure for other packages, not a runtime dependency of any shipped library.

banned_construct_exceptions.justification: Raw libc calls for seccomp, Landlock, prctl and the negative-control probes; each unsafe block states why its arguments are valid.
